title: Mock a collaborator
summary: Replace a dependency so the unit under test stays isolated.
description: Tax rate comes from a service. Vitest and Jest use `vi.fn` / `jest.fn`; pytest uses a simple stub or `unittest.mock`.
architecture: priceWithTax() asks a collaborator for a tax rate. The test replaces that collaborator with a fake that returns 0.1, then checks both the computed price and that the fake was called with the region code. Isolation is the point: we do not hit a real tax API.

variants.label: pytest
variants.notes: Uses unittest.mock.Mock — the same idea as vi.fn() / jest.fn().
